jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
We are a high-growth company transforming how businesses operate by integrating AI, IoT, and cloud-native services into scalable, real-time platforms. As a Platform Data Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in building and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our products, services, and insights.  
  
You’ll join a multidisciplinary team focused on ingesting, processing, and managing massive streams of sensor and operational data across a wide array of devices—from drones and robots to industrial systems and smart environments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable, and high-throughput data ingestion pipelines for structured and semi-structured data.
* Implement robust and secure data lake and SQL-based storage architectures optimized for performance and cost.
* Develop and maintain internal tools and frameworks for data ingestion using Python, Golang, and SQL.
* Build and maintain inference pipelines to support model serving and near real time prediction workflows
* Develop and maintain internal tools and deployment processes to support ML development workflow , including experimentation, testing, deployment and monitoring.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Cloud, Edge, Product, and AI teams to define data contracts, schemas, and retention policies.
* Use AWS cloud infrastructure (including Argo Workflows, S3, Lambda, Glue, Kinesis, Athena, and RDS) to support end-to-end data workflows.
* Employ Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) practices using Terraform to manage data platform infrastructure.
* Monitor data pipelines for quality, latency, and failures using tools such as CloudWatch, SumoLogic, or DataDog.
* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines that land curated sensor and operational data into Delta tables on Databricks to support ML experimentation and model training.
* Continuously optimize storage, partitioning, and query performance across large-scale datasets.
* Participate in architecture reviews and ensure the platform adheres to security, compliance, and best practice standards.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering or data engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python and Golang.
* Deep understanding of SQL and modern data lake architectures (e.g., using Parquet, Iceberg, or Delta Lake).
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including but not limited to: S3, Lambda, Glue, Kinesis, Athena, and RDS.
* Proficiency with Terraform for automating infrastructure deployment and management.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks for ML workflows: MLflow experiment tracking and model registry, Model Serving, and building training datasets in Delta Lake (PySpark/Spark SQL).
* Experience working with real-time or batch data ingestion at scale, and designing fault-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines.
* Familiarity with DVC for dataset versioning and management.
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures and messaging systems like Kafka or Kinesis.
* Strong debugging and optimization skills across cloud, network, and application layers.
* Excellent collaboration, communication, and documentation skills.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience working with time-series or IoT sensor data at industrial scale.
* Exposure to gRPC and protobuf-based data contracts.
* Experience supporting ML pipelines and feature stores.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes concepts.
* Databricks Machine Learning certification (Professional)
* Prior startup experience and/or comfort working in fast-paced, iterative environments.

**Location: Palo Alto (hybrid)**

  

ERGO NEXT's mission is to help entrepreneurs thrive. We're doing that by building the only technology-led, full-stack provider of small business insurance in the industry, taking on the entire value chain and transforming the customer experience.

  

Simply put, wherever you find small businesses, you'll find ERGO NEXT.

  

Since 2016, we've helped hundreds of thousands of small business customers across the United States get fast, customized and affordable coverage. We're backed by industry leaders in insurance and tech, and we still have room to grow — that's where you come in.

  

As a Growth Data Scientist, you will use data to help shape how ERGO NEXT reaches, serves, and converts customers across our **partnership channel** and **customer experience funnel**. You will work closely with Product and Partnerships teams to identify growth opportunities, understand customer behavior, and turn insights into product and business decisions.

  

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical and statistical skills with business judgment, curiosity, and a bias toward action. You should be comfortable working through ambiguous questions, developing a point of view, and using both traditional data science methods and emerging AI capabilities to make analysis more scalable, efficient, and impactful.

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Use AI as part of the day-to-day data science workflow and identify opportunities to develop reusable AI-enabled tools, skills, or agents that solve practical analytical and business problems.
* Drive strategy and roadmap for the Partnership channel and the customer experience funnel through actionable data insights.
* Own analytics for the entire customer experience funnel, from acquired opportunities to purchases.
* Design and evaluate experiments and causal analyses to measure the impact of product, funnel, and customer experience changes and guide future strategic decisions.
* Analyze affiliates performance across the partnership channel, identifying differences in traffic quality, conversion, product mix, and customer behavior to uncover opportunities to improve partner growth and customer outcomes.
* Identify, size, and prioritize growth opportunities, translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous analyses and actionable recommendations.
* Apply statistical analysis, segmentation, modeling, and deep-dive analysis to understand the underlying drivers of business performance.
* Define clear metrics, measurement frameworks, and visualizations to help business monitor performance and make data driven decisions.

  

**What We Need:**

* [4+] years of experience in Data Science or other highly quantitative analytical roles (experience working in fintech or growth & partnerships is a plus).
* Ability to quickly learn new AI capabilities, identify meaningful gaps in existing workflows, and apply or develop practical AI-enabled solutions that improve how data science work gets done.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience using Python or R for statistical analysis and analytical workflows.
* Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference.
* Experience with experiment design, implementation, analysis, and recommendation for actionable insights
* Ability to define the appropriate metric framework to empower the data-driven decision-making process
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience analyzing customer journeys, conversion funnels, or growth with the ability to connect changes in metrics to underlying business drivers.
* Experience working with partnership or other multi-channel business models, with the ability to evaluate partner performance.

  

**Unstoppable Qualities:**

* A builder mindset, with an interest in using data, automation, and AI to turn recurring analytical problems into scalable capabilities for the broader organization.

jobs.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.  
  
We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Software Engineer - Manipulation is a core contributor to our robot's ability to interact with the world reliably and precisely. This role is responsible for developing and deploying learning-based manipulation policies, with a focus on post-training methods that adapt and improve those policies on real tasks and physical hardware.

This role will bridge the gap between cutting-edge research and scalable, reliable production software. * **Manipulation:** Strong experience in robotic manipulation, including grasping, in-hand or whole-arm control, and high-DOF motion, with a track record of hardware deployment.

**About Trellis**  
Trellis builds AI that handles intake, benefits, prior authorization and reimbursement for infusion and specialty pharmacy providers, so patients start therapy faster and providers get paid for it.

**The role**  
You will be our expert on infusion prior authorization and reimbursement. Our system reads referrals, clinical notes and payer policies, then prepares the work that intake and reimbursement teams do by hand today. Your job is to make sure that work is right. You will review real cases across our customers, catch what the system gets wrong and explain why. Then you turn that judgment into rules and test cases our engineers build on. You will work directly with the product and engineering team.

**What you will do**

* Review prior authorization and reimbursement cases for infusion customers, covering benefits, coverage, PA requirements, medical necessity, billing codes and units
* Check each decision against payer policies, Medicare LCDs and NCDs, payer portals and the patient's clinical documentation
* Build answer keys that record the correct outcome for real cases, with the reasoning and source behind each call
* Find patterns in errors and write them up clearly for product and engineering, with examples
* Keep a working library of payer rules, drug coverage criteria and billing conventions up to date
* Learn how customer intake and reimbursement staff handle edge cases, and bring those conventions into the product
* Review early output during customer onboarding and flag risk before it reaches a claim

**What you bring**

* 3+ years in infusion or specialty pharmacy revenue cycle, such as prior authorization, benefits verification, billing, denials or appeals
* Working knowledge of medical versus pharmacy benefit, buy and bill, HCPCS J codes, administration CPT codes, NDC to billing unit conversion and modifiers
* Comfort reading LCDs, NCDs and commercial medical policies and applying them to a specific patient
* Experience with payer portals and PA tools such as Availity or CoverMyMeds, and pharmacy or infusion systems such as CPR+ or WellSky
* Careful judgment. You know the difference between what the chart says and what someone assumed
* Clear writing. You can explain a denial risk in two sentences to someone who has never billed a claim

**Nice to have**

* A CPC, CPB, CRCS or similar certification, or a pharmacy technician or nursing background
* Experience at a home infusion provider, ambulatory infusion center or specialty pharmacy
* Experience with biologics, IVIG and other high cost therapies across Medicare, Medicaid and commercial plans
* Curiosity about how AI can change healthcare operations. No coding required

**About the interview**
-----------------------

* **Intro call with Ahmed (30 min).** Your background, the kind of reimbursement work you have done, and what you want next.
* **Case review exercise (60 to 90 min).** We share two or three anonymized infusion referrals with the relevant payer policy. You decide whether a PA is needed, whether the case meets coverage criteria, and how it should be billed. Then we go through your reasoning together. We care more about how you think and where you look than about a perfect answer.
* **Team conversations (45 min).** Meet the people on product and engineering you will work with every day, and ask anything about how we build.
* **References and offer.** We move quickly and will tell you where you stand after each step.

Compensation Range: $70K - $120K
